operating_notes.text: Omaxe received RERA approval for Omaxe Royal Nest in Ludhiana, Punjab (PBRERA-LDH44-PR1370-042026) valid till January 31, 2031.
Subsidiary Omaxe Garv Buildtech received RERA registration for COMMERCIAL-3 BLOCK-3 in Lucknow (UPRERAPRJ787830/04/2026) valid till December 17, 2030.
Omaxe Cassia in Lucknow: ₹250 Cr investment, 360 units across eight towers, nearly 300 sold before full construction, delivery slated within three years.
Subsidiary Omaxe Garv Buildtech received U.P. RERA registrations for Commercial-3 Block-1 and Commercial-3 Block-2 in Lucknow, valid till December 17, 2030.
WSB Partners invested ₹75 Cr in Omaxe Group against residential plotted projects in Ujjain and Indore, mainly as growth capital.
Entered into an MOU with Carnation Hotels (Lemon Tree Hotels subsidiary) to operate 10 hotel projects with 4,000 keys, involving an estimated investment of ₹4,000 crore.
Received U.P. RERA registration for Commercial and Service Apartment at Eternity - 2 in Mathura valid till April 1, 2031.
Omaxe Limited approved the incorporation of a wholly owned subsidiary for real estate projects under the Public-Private Partnership (PPP) model with an initial subscription of ₹1 lakh.
Reported Q2FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹575.51 Cr with a net loss of ₹25.55 Cr.

timeline.summary: Omaxe received Punjab RERA registration for its residential plotted project Omaxe Royal Nest in Ludhiana on April 22, 2026.
On April 23, 2026, Omaxe announced that its subsidiary received U.P. RERA registration for the COMMERCIAL-3 BLOCK-3 project in Lucknow.
On April 29, 2026, Omaxe announced a ₹250 Cr investment in Omaxe Cassia, a 360-unit Lucknow project by subsidiary Omaxe Garv Buildtech, with nearly 300 units already sold as construction began.
Omaxe subsidiary received U.P. RERA registrations for Commercial-3 Block-1 and Block-2 projects in Lucknow on May 7, 2026.

Annay Realtors Private Limited, on behalf of its promoter group (Sunil Goel, Sunil Goel HUF, Seema Goel, Jai Bhagwan Goel, Rekha Goel, Nakul Goel), declared no new encumbrances under SEBI’s Takeover Regulations on 03.04.2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹348.52 Cr (-35.6% YoY), net loss ₹191.42 Cr (against a loss of ₹148.67 Cr a year earlier).
On May 19, 2026, Omaxe said WSB Partners invested ₹75 Cr in the group against residential plotted projects in Ujjain and Indore.
Sushma Goel (Member-Promoter Group of Omaxe Limited) declared no new encumbrances under SEBI Takeover Regulations on 03.04.2026, excluding related parties.
Jai Bhagwan Goel (Promoter) of Omaxe Limited declared no encumbrances on 9,98,650 (0.55%) shares as of March 31, 2026, under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).

Dream Home Developers Private Limited, under KR Sharma (Director), declares no new encumbrances by promoter group (Sunil Goel, HUF, Seema Goel, Jai Bhagwan Goel, Rekha Goel, Nakul Goel) for FY2025-26.

Guild Builders Private Limited, under **Shaha Nawaz** (Director), declared no new encumbrances on Omaxe Limited shares for FY2025-26, excluding **Mr. Sunil Goel**, **Sunil Goel HUF**, **Mrs. Seema Goel**, **Mr. Jai Bhagwan Goel**, **Mrs. Rekha Goel**, and **Mr. Nakul Goel** (Promoters).
Rekha Goel (Independent Non-Consulting Relative) declared 9,00,000 (0.49%) Omaxe shares held as of March 31, 2026, with no encumbrances in FY2025-26.
Omaxe signed an MOU with Lemon Tree Hotels' subsidiary to operate 10 hotel projects with 4,000 keys, involving an estimated investment of ₹4,000 crore.
Omaxe received U.P. RERA registration for its Commercial and Service Apartment at Eternity - 2 project in Mathura.
Omaxe Limited approved the incorporation of a new wholly owned subsidiary to undertake real estate projects under the PPP model with an initial subscription of ₹1 lakh.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹575.51 Cr (+79.4% YoY), net loss ₹25.55 Cr (against a loss of ₹166.42 Cr a year earlier).
